name: GIN-Dock-Wallpaper
description: Unified Smart Hot-Corner Dock Bar & 4K Wallpaper Calendar HUD Engine for Windows 10/11
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev & Antigravity
features: Zero-Scrollbar Pure Fit: Removed AutoScroll across all tabs and compacted vertical coordinates so all controls, fonts, and action buttons fit cleanly with zero scrollbars
Compact Tab 2 Vertical Rhythm: Reduced category row step to 18px and font grid step to 25px; wallpaper action buttons now end at Y=508px well inside the tab frame
Full-Width Action Buttons: Expanded 'Сохранить текущие обои в Изображения' to 350px width preventing any text cutoff
24 Curated Fonts & Calendar Scale: Expanded calligraphic and graphic typography with clean 'Off' toggle and preview buttons
Pure Standalone Binary Distribution: Zero external scripts; 666KB native WinAPI setup installer
